name: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University
summary: Bilingual university in Beppu, founded 2000: three colleges where you can enrol, study and graduate in English, with students from over 100 countries.

ib.text: IB Diploma accepted with predicted grades (eligibility is revoked if the Diploma is not awarded). English-basis applicants need IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 75 or Duolingo 110, unless the Diploma was taught in English.

apply.via: APU Online Application System, with a recorded interview

dates.label: Round 2 (GFA2) opens, other countries and regions

programmes.name: College of Asia Pacific Studies (APS)
programmes.about: Political systems, economies, societies and cultures of the Asia Pacific region, in three areas: culture, society and media; international relations; and global economy. A shared liberal-arts first year comes before major courses.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents plus a 30-minute recorded online interview; no trip to Japan. About 135 international places for September 2027.
programmes.closesNote: Last of four rounds for applicants living outside Japan.

programmes.name: College of International Management (APM)
programmes.about: Business studied in four areas: strategic management and leadership, marketing, accounting and finance, and entrepreneurship and operations management. The college holds AACSB and AMBA accreditation.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents plus a 30-minute recorded online interview; no trip to Japan. About 240 international places for September 2027.
programmes.closesNote: Last of four rounds for applicants living outside Japan.

programmes.name: College of Sustainability and Tourism (ST)
programmes.about: Sustainable societies through environmental resource management and sustainable tourism, with nine concentrations spanning development, tourism, environment and entrepreneurship, and learning beyond the classroom.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents plus a 30-minute recorded online interview; no trip to Japan. About 90 international places for September 2027.
programmes.closesNote: Last of four rounds for applicants living outside Japan.

notes: APU says most courses run in both English and Japanese so you can graduate in either, but English-basis students must also take Japanese language subjects.
The schedule above is for applicants living in countries other than China, India, Indonesia, Korea, Thailand and Viet Nam, which each have their own dates.
APU's tuition reduction scholarship (100%, 80%, 65%, 50% or 30%) is decided from an essay and recommendation letter submitted with the application; the application fee is ¥5,500 from outside Japan.
